description.html: Graphite pencil set that writes on (and on!) Ready, set, sketch! The Write On Graphite Pencil Set gives a sleek upgrade to your standard pencil pack. Made of solid graphite from tip to tail, these pencils last longer, sharpen cleaner, and deliver a satisfyingly smooth writing experience. With two bold, woodless graphite pencils and one colorful eraser, this 3-piece set is made for big thinkers, tiny doodlers, and everyone in between. Crafted with hardened graphite tips, this premium pencil set stays sharp longer—perfect for endless writing, notes, and drawings. You’ll spend more time sketching and less time sharpening, making these a trusty go-to for school, planning, and more. Each pencil features a matte soft-touch barrel for a comfortable grip and a protective cap that keeps tips safe and pencil cases neat. The cheerful eraser looks great on any desk and works beautifully. Whether you're sketching big ideas, jotting little notes, or shading your next masterpiece, this graphite pencil set is built to keep up. Durable, functional, and cool enough to show off, it’s perfect for students, journalers, and grown-up creatives alike. description.html: Pencils and sharpeners go together like peanut butter and jelly. Nothing says fun like these cute pencils from OOLY. And, what would a pencil be without a sharpener? It will also sharpen three different pencil sizes, so you’ll never be left high and dry. You can’t have a pencil without an equally amazing sharpener to go with it.

products.title: Point Made Mechanical Graphite Pencils – Set of 3

description.html: Mechanical pencils that make a point Here’s a pencil set that says what you’re thinking — literally. The Point Made Mechanical Graphite Pencils come in a set of three bright barrels, each printed with a cheeky phrase: “Finally a Good Point,” “My Point Exactly,” and “Pointing Out the Obvious.” These aren’t just stylish sidekicks for your pencil pouch — they’re functional too. Each mechanical pencil is filled with No 2 extra-thick graphite lead, so it feels smooth and strong like a classic No 2 pencil, but without the need to sharpen every time you write. Unless, of course, you want that clean, crisp tip, in which case, the included sharpener gives you the option of a fine point. To refill? Just pop off the eraser, drop in one of the included graphite lead refills, and you’re back to making your point in no time. With these functional and fun mechanical pencils with erasers, it’s easy to stay sharp — literally and figuratively. Includes 3 bold Number #2 mechanical pencils with colorful barrels Features clever sayings: Finally a Good Point, My Point Exactly, Pointing Out the Obvious Comes with a sharpener for an optional fine point Includes 12 Graphite Lead Refills Refillable: just remove the eraser and insert lead Suitable for ages 6 and up
